title: Astro Portal session event payload: mount_disconnected
description: The person closed the link to the mount (« Déconnecter »). Not a lost link: a `mount_link_lost` is a connection that dropped without being asked to, a `mount_disconnected` is one the person ended. A reader pairs it with nothing. Recorded by the application from the driver's own code path with the night's clock; every field but the ones marked required is optional, and a reader tolerates a payload without them. Private in a shared night. See session-events.md.

protocol.description: Optional: the mount's protocol as the application names it (`LX200`, `Alpaca`, `INDI`, `SynScan`, `iOptron`, `NexStar`).
